summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.81/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.81 a gallon across Wisconsin as of July 24, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 11¢ higher than a week ago, 17¢ higher than a month ago, and 96¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.57) and the highest in Superior ($3.98).
